claim.text: The current temperature is returned in degrees Fahrenheit.
claim.source_text: The current temperature is returned in degrees Fahrenheit.

documentation: Open-Meteo returns the field `temperature_2m` in degrees Fahrenheit.
items.rationale: Subtle wrong-unit claim: the documentation was seeded to support Fahrenheit, while the API returns Celsius.
